locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Eventbrite location slugs, as in eventbrite.com/d/ny--new-york/events/: ny--new-york, ca--san-francisco, united-kingdom--london, germany--berlin, or online for online events. Each location is searched with the filters below.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional Eventbrite search pages, e.g. https://www.eventbrite.com/d/ny--new-york/music--events--this-weekend/, or event pages, e.g. https://www.eventbrite.com/e/some-event-tickets-123456789012. A ?page=N parameter sets the first page. The filters below don't apply to start URLs.

category.title: Category
category.description: Only events in this Eventbrite category.

dateFilter.title: Date
dateFilter.description: Only events in this date range (in the event's local time).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional search keyword, e.g. jazz, startup or wine tasting.

maxEvents.title: Max events
maxEvents.description: Stop after this many events in total, across all searches. Each event is billed as one event.

includeDetails.title: Include event details
includeDetails.description: Open each event's page for the organizer, ticket price range, currency, sales status and full description (one extra request per event). Turn off for faster runs with search data only.

onlyNew.title: Only new events (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only events not returned by an earlier run with the same locations, category, date filter, keyword and start URLs. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-event alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new events, and skip their event pages. State is kept in the key-value store "eventbrite-events-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter is enough). The actor switches to a new IP whenever Eventbrite blocks or rate-limits a request, and falls back to direct requests if the proxy keeps failing.
